name: Kernel-Modulated Neural Representation for Light Fields
aliases: Implicit Convolutional Network for Light Fields
definition: A compact neural representation for light fields that uses switchable convolutional kernels (modulators) guided by angular coordinates to render specific views, while shared kernels (descriptors) store common scene information, avoiding parameter explosion in high angular resolution.
summary: Kernel-Modulated Neural Representation is a compact implicit neural model that maps noise to light field images by decomposing kernels into shared descriptors and view-specific modulators to avoid parameter explosion.
